objectives.summary: Pick a fixed workflow or autonomous agent from risk and audit needs; split orchestrator and subagents; choose the runtime.
Write and fix Agent SDK agent definitions, loops and hook setups so required steps always run regardless of what the model chooses.
Read an agent trace, spot the missing or misused pattern (loop stopping, isolation, memory, context limits) and choose the fix.
Use Messages API features correctly: turns, tools, streaming, images, thinking, caching, schemas, stop reasons, realtime vs batch.
Judge an app design: instruction behavior per surface, data crossing the app boundary, and whether schema and session choices fit.
Derive the right config from its files and pipeline (memory files, settings, model pins, prompt versions, plugins, CI) per environment.
Debug failing integration code from its errors: stream event handling, retries blind to error classes, flawed multi-format file ingestion.
Operate Claude Code on every surface: sessions, memory layering, settings, permission modes, non-interactive use, built-in commands.
Match a recurring team workflow to the right extension type, then build and package it for sharing.
Build an eval for a stated quality target: human-calibrated model judges, reference sets, regression suites, defensible metrics.
Read a trace or repro to name the failure type, locate whether the fault is in the integration or the model, and fix the cause.
Explain and steer observed model behavior using tokens, context size, sampling randomness, and thinking and effort settings.
Pick a model tier balancing quality, speed and spend under hard limits; plan for behavior shifts across releases with regression evals.
Find what drives spend from usage data, apply the fitting lever (caching, batching, token limits) and estimate the savings.
Repair long sessions whose context turns noisy or strays: compaction, trimming tool results, subagent delegation, or a fresh start.
Rework a prompt so output matches intent after evals show a gap: clearer wording, placement, examples, output limits, input cleaning.
Keep downstream code safe from malformed model output via enforced schemas, response checks, and guarded handling of unstructured replies.
Base answers only on supplied documents, with attribution and a not-found path; pick full context or retrieval on size, cost, freshness.
Assess how an agent reading untrusted input could be hijacked or talked out of its rules; layer defenses against leaks and rogue actions.
Layer guardrails, minimal privileges and hooks so harmful operations are blocked deterministically even against hostile instructions.
Manage Anthropic keys safely: keep them server-side, scope them by workspace, separate environments, rotate and monitor use.
Implement a tool end to end: schema, guiding description, lean results, errors, execution side, approvals, and the assembled tool set.
Build, deploy and connect an MCP server exposing resources, tools and prompts, choosing a transport and handling auth.
Choose between skills, MCP servers, and native or bespoke tools: where the capability lives, who owns it, how Claude finds and calls it.
